verdict.rationale: SumUp's managed MCP server lets an agent review transactions, and API keys and the JS SDK give programmatic access, so the transaction-pulling half of the story is documented. Nothing in the pack covers a payouts or settlements endpoint, and nothing covers reconciling daily takings into a ledger or accounting system. missing for 10: documented payouts/settlement retrieval via API, daily takings or reconciliation reporting, ledger/accounting export or integration, independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent doing reconciliation.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull transactions and payouts via API and reconcile daily takings into my ledger

citations.quote: Query your merchant profile and review transactions.
SumUp runs a managed MCP server at https://mcp.sumup.com/mcp. This endpoint allows your MCP client to interact with SumUp APIs to manage your account
Use your AI assistant to build SumUp payment integrations, troubleshoot checkout flows, or query your merchant account.
API keys are static credentials that let your application act on behalf of the merchant account that created the key.
